title: Akihabara for Perry: 3 ways to spend the day
h1: Three ways to spend the day.
lead: Three plans for your day, all 10:00 to 15:00. Pick by what you want to see; I can shorten any of them if the jet lag is heavy.
subject: Perry — Akihabara plan
meet_sub: The same start for every course
meet_text: Meet at 10:00 on the 1st floor of BiTO AKIBA. If you would rather I come to you, I can meet you in your hotel lobby instead.
meet_hint: It is the Vie de France cafe on the 1st floor of BiTO AKIBA, a short walk from the Electric Town exit of Akihabara Station.
footer: Reply to Yuuki with the letter of the course you want. Times are approximate and can move on the day.
note: Checked on the shops' official sites in October 2026. None lists a regular closing day on a Tuesday or Wednesday, but Shibuya PARCO closes on irregular days. I will re-check the week before.
